precision_scope.sweep_scope: fp64 only: binary64 stored coefficients, binary64 evaluation, targets rel:1e-13 and abs:5e-14

method.count_unit: (m + 1) numerator coefficients + k denominator coefficients, q_0 held at 1
method.certified: the smallest stored count at which some (m,k) pair with k <= 12 meets the target on the full 4,001-node grid; the count below it is settled by solving every pair there, not a coarse scan
method.batch: count_sweep.refine_pairs with its acceptance threshold set to infinity, so every solved pair's delivered error is returned; the ladder target is applied to the fits by count_sweep.meets
method.walk: start at the record's stored count minus one; if a pair meets there, walk down while the count below still has a meeting pair; otherwise check the record count and, if no pair meets, walk up to the first count that does
method.target_semantics: relative to F_0(x) at each node, the ladder's own reading
